questions: Can a persistent context survive the executor loop?
Does same-model speculation yield a speedup?

findings.detail: llama-cpp-2 0.1.133 exposes clear_kv_cache_seq (llama_memory_seq_rm reject-suffix rollback), clear_kv_cache, kv_cache_seq_pos_max, incremental decode. KV mechanism fully supported.
backend.rs:207/175 verify_tokens/generate_from_tokens create a fresh context + re-decode the whole context from pos 0 each call -> O(n)/step x2 waste that trips auto_disable.

executor.rs:54 is stateless (passes full growing context slice) but only pushes committed tokens -> backend sees a monotone committed prefix; persistent KV need only decode the delta + roll back speculative positions.

LOAD-BEARING: LlamaBackendInner owns model by value; create_context(&self)->LlamaContext<'_> borrows it -> a persistent context is a self-referential struct (needs self_cell/ouroboros or a loop owning both in-scope).
same-model caveat: repo has one model (qwen-0.5b); draft==target => always-accept; headline >1x needs a cheaper draft (small model or model-free prompt-lookup/n-gram).
verifiable locally (models/qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf present, tests/e2e_model_test.rs:18) though not in CI (model absent).
